meta.description: Every etched number on the Voyager record cover. valueTH is the exact integer; numbers are in hydrogen time units t_H = 1/1420405751.768 Hz except rasterLines and lineLabels (counts).

svgUnits.angleZero: mapAngleDeg is counter-clockwise from the drawn galactic-centre line (gcLine.svgAzimuthDeg); svgAzimuthDeg is the raw azimuth from the SVG +x axis, counter-clockwise with SVG y flipped
svgUnits.originNote: origin: our least-squares intersection of the long radial strokes (svgmap.find_origin), used for every value here; originResearch: the undocumented origin of the research digitization, 0.55 units away (0.0003 R0), kept for reference only

lineLabels.location: Top right: above each of the three picture lines in the start-of-picture diagram
lineLabels.provenance: NASA/JPL photo GPN-2000-001978 (1977), pixel scan in docs/research/cover.md section 1c; matches NASA cover page and Ron Barry

lineLabels.location: Top right: above each of the three picture lines in the start-of-picture diagram
lineLabels.provenance: NASA/JPL photo GPN-2000-001978 (1977), pixel scan in docs/research/cover.md section 1c; matches NASA cover page and Ron Barry

lineLabels.location: Top right: above each of the three picture lines in the start-of-picture diagram
lineLabels.provenance: NASA/JPL photo GPN-2000-001978 (1977), pixel scan in docs/research/cover.md section 1c; matches NASA cover page and Ron Barry

lineTime.location: Top right: under picture line 1, between two tall bars, in 3 rows (12/8/4 digits)
lineTime.meaning: Duration of one picture line (8.34 ms), in hydrogen time units
lineTime.provenance: NASA/JPL photo GPN-2000-001978 (1977), pixel scan in docs/research/cover.md section 1c; matches Carter Dack, CED Magic and Ron Barry transcriptions

notes: Disputed, not a value: a small two-row label above the first raster lines. The research read it as 1, 10, 11 (lines 1 to 3); CED Magic reads 10000 = 16 ("16 grey levels"). No official source explains it (cover.md 1c, Could not confirm 4).

rasterLines.location: Top right: above the last line of the raster rectangle, in vertical notation (a horizontal bar plus 9 dashes in columns of 5 and 4)
rasterLines.meaning: Number of vertical lines in one picture (512)
rasterLines.provenance: NASA/JPL photo GPN-2000-001978 (1977), pixel scan in docs/research/cover.md section 1c; matches CED Magic and Carter Dack; NASA: "512 vertical lines"

conventions.absZOverR0: |z| = distance from the outer end of the solid line back to its tick, over R0; the sign of z is not encoded (SSD72)
conventions.binary: period in hydrogen time units; most significant bit nearest the origin
conventions.breakR0: gap in the solid line, [start, end] over R0; a broken line means the distance was not accurately known (SSD72)
conventions.mapAngleDeg: counter-clockwise from the drawn galactic-centre line; equals galactic longitude (cover.md 1d); the median azimuth of the stroke midpoints of the line beyond 60 SVG units, minus gcLine.svgAzimuthDeg
conventions.rOverR0: solid-line length = in-plane distance d cos b, over R0
conventions.svgAzimuthDeg: raw azimuth from the SVG +x axis, counter-clockwise with SVG y flipped (lines and the centre line)

gcLine.meaning: Sun to galactic-centre distance R0; its tick is precisely at its end (z = 0); the unit of every map distance (SSD72, cover.md 1d)
gcLine.provenance: Pioneer plaque vector trace (Mysid 2006, Wikimedia Commons Pioneer_plaque.svg), extracted by tools/data/svgmap.py; the Voyager map is the Pioneer map (docs/research/cover.md 1f)

playTime.location: Top left: side view of the record, written in 5 rows (9/10/10/10/4 digits) between two tall bars
playTime.meaning: Playing time of one side (53.8 min), in hydrogen time units
playTime.provenance: NASA/JPL photo GPN-2000-001978 (1977), pixel scan in docs/research/cover.md section 1b; matches Carter Dack and CED Magic transcriptions

rotationPeriod.location: Top left: around the plan view of the record, read counter-clockwise from the mark next to the cartridge
rotationPeriod.meaning: Time for one rotation of the record (3.6 s, 16 2/3 rpm), in hydrogen time units
rotationPeriod.provenance: NASA/JPL photo GPN-2000-001978 (1977), pixel scan in docs/research/cover.md section 1b; matches Carter Dack (carterdack.com/Voyager) and CED Magic (cedmagic.com) transcriptions
